title: BIO
text: KELLY LINK is the author of the collections Stranger Things Happen , Magic for Beginners , The Wrong Grave and Pretty Monsters . Her short stories have been published in The Magazine of Fantasy & Science Fiction , The Best American Short Stories , and Prize Stories: The O. Henry Awards . Link is the co-founder of Small Beer Press. She was born in Miami, Florida and now lives with her husband and daughter in Northampton, Massachusetts. kellylink.net
